hero.subtitle: The story of an agency born in Yaoundé with a world-class bar.

story.p1: CDA was born from a simple observation: Cameroonian businesses deserve the same level of digital execution as those in Paris, London, or San Francisco.
story.p2: Findi founded CDA in Yaoundé with one conviction: the talent is here, the tools are now accessible — all that was missing was the standard.
story.p3: AI is changing the rules. For the first time, an SME in Yaoundé can operate with the precision of a multinational — with the right partner.
story.p4: The lion is not just a symbol. It's our standard: presence, patience, precision.

q1.a: Every project is quoted individually. A showcase site starts around a few hundred thousand FCFA; a full platform with AI is discussed in session. You always leave with a clear range before any commitment.

q2.a: A showcase site: 2 to 4 weeks. A full identity: 3 weeks. The Signature Offer: 30 days. Software projects depend on scope — we commit to dates, not promises.

q3.q: I already have a Facebook page. Why a website?
q3.a: Facebook is rented ground: the algorithm decides who sees you. Your website is your own land. The two work together — one captures attention, the other converts it.

q4.a: MTN Mobile Money, Orange Money, or bank transfer. Installment plans are available on most projects.

q5.a: We don't disappear. Maintenance, content, campaigns: monthly support plans exist, with no forced commitment.
